record.title: Strong Thin Tree Conjecture
record.statement: For every $k$-edge-connected graph, the guarantee that a spanning tree contains only an $O(1/k)$ fraction of the edges across each cut can be obtained for all cuts simultaneously.
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2024/50](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/14298804), page 40. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.
